# Plan B Careers

> Career, job-search and admission guidance from Akola for candidates in Vidarbha and beyond.

Plan B Careers provides guidance and application assistance. Employers and institutions make selection decisions. A listing does not establish an exclusive recruitment partnership or guarantee an outcome.

## Contact and location

- Website: https://planbcareers.in
- Phone: +91 94205 12501
- Email: contact.planbcareers@gmail.com
- Confirmed office: Near City Kotwali, Akola, Maharashtra. Contact the team to arrange a visit and confirm directions.
- Service areas: Akola, Vidarbha, Maharashtra. Service areas do not imply staffed branches.

## Service terms

Service scope and any charges are discussed directly with the team for your situation. Ask for the scope, amount and applicable refund terms in writing before agreeing or paying. Hiring decisions remain with the employer.

## Authoritative pages

- [Current job listings](https://planbcareers.in/jobs): Open source records, with individual duties and application links.
- [Jobs and support in Akola](https://planbcareers.in/jobs/location-akola): Local workplace inventory is separated from remote alternatives.
- [Vidarbha job-search guide](https://planbcareers.in/jobs-vidarbha): How to compare local, remote and relocation options.
- [Career guidance in Akola](https://planbcareers.in/career-guidance-akola): How to prepare for a discussion with the Akola team.
- [Work-from-home listings](https://planbcareers.in/jobs/work-from-home): Remote work requirements and compensation explained.
- [Career resources](https://planbcareers.in/resources): Resume, interview, salary and job-offer safety guides.
- [About Plan B Careers](https://planbcareers.in/about): Business identity and scope of assistance.
- [Contact and directions](https://planbcareers.in/contact): Current public contact information and confirmed office details.
- [Service scope and charges](https://planbcareers.in/service-fees): Discuss the applicable service and terms directly.
- [Trust and verification guidance](https://planbcareers.in/trust): How to check a listing, offer and recruitment process.
- [Privacy policy](https://planbcareers.in/privacy-policy): Personal data and application information.
- [Refund policy](https://planbcareers.in/refund-policy): Terms to check before agreeing to a paid service.
